_about: Kiln, 19 Oct 2026. Every shot after the intro moves (decision 'animate everything after the intro'). engine: sing = InfiniteTalk lip sync to the window's vocal; act = Wan 2.2 image-to-video from the picked plate, mouth closed unless said; grok = Lati makes it in Grok Imagine (mouth-closed action); graphic = motion design only. {look} = her look, {full} = her look head to toe. Prompts say what moves and how the camera moves, nothing about text or graphics (those are composited).
